_comment: Issue #81 (exploration & optional content): 'The Missing Recruit' end to end, POSTING-SEEDED. FIXTURE-FIRST (near_missing_recruit -- the quest content is the subject, not the door transitions already proven by guild_interior_walkthrough/gate_district_walkthrough). Proves, in order: (1) a REAL guild_board browse banks heard_about_missing_recruit (rumor_missing_recruit, data/skeleton_scene.json) -- the same board also carries rumor_lost_hammer, banked as a side effect (every rumor fires on every browse, THE REQUEST BOARD's existing behavior); (2) Dresk's gated 'ask' option starts the quest (quest_started + the 'New quest:' toast); (3) recruit_pell -- ABSENT until missing_recruit_started banks (present_when, a DIFFERENT map than the producer) -- is found in the sewers and banks the beat-1 counter, live; (4) the journal's new Lore section picks up note_sewer_surveyor, found en route; (5) walking back to Dresk and reporting completes beat 2 + the whole quest (quest_beat_completed x2, quest_completed, the 4-gold payout through the shared earn_gold router). Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).

steps._comment: == (1) THE REQUEST BOARD == (8,3) down3 -> (8,6), left7 -> (1,6), up3 -> (1,3) (the board_loop.json proven route), right1 blocks on guild_board (2,3) & faces it. Reading the board banks BOTH #81 rumors (this quest reads exactly one of them, the other rides along) plus the pre-existing three.

_interact_board banks read_the_board + every board_rumors accomplishment BEFORE opening the code-built dialogue (wi_game.gd's own ordering) -- wait for the rumor bank first, dialogue_started second, or the since-marker cursor would advance past an already-fired accomplishment_recorded and this wait would time out.

== (2) DRESK, ASK == teleport to the barracks (the overworld walk between guild/barracks/sewers is proven elsewhere -- gate_district_walkthrough/barracks_walkthrough/sewers_walkthrough; the subject here is the quest content), landing beside duty_sergeant (6,4). First interact is the talk_pool bark (fresh waking, social_talked unset); second interact reaches the real dresk_recruit graph. Visible options: [0] Just checking in., [1] Heard a recruit's gone missing. (the report option stays hidden -- found_missing_recruit isn't banked yet).

payload_contains.speaker: Sergeant Ashgrave
payload_contains.text: If you're here to report something, report it plain. The belt-slate does the writing; you do the talking.

payload_contains.speaker: Sergeant Ashgrave
payload_contains.text: Pell. Green, keen, checks every noise personally instead of logging it and moving on. Went to look at scratching in the drainage gallery two musters back. Hasn't reported since. Not panicking. Yet.

steps._comment: == (3) THE SEWERS, FOR REAL == teleport beside the sewer_grate (15,9), then a REAL door_when interact (heard_about_cisterns is pre-banked in the fixture) descends to sewers (2,2), the sewers_walkthrough precedent. recruit_pell now EXISTS (present_when: missing_recruit_started, banked on the barracks map above -- a DIFFERENT map than sewers, satisfying entity_present's own constraint) -- 14 entities (the pre-#81 10 + note_sewer_surveyor + recruit_pell + R6's (#95) sewer_nest_snag/sewer_drain_snare trap placements) + PC = 15. RE-PINNED (class-foundation R6): was 13 before the 2 new trap props landed off this canonical's own walked-cell set (no route change, count only).

payload_contains.text: You set your shoulder to the grate. The rust gives with a shriek, and cold air breathes up out of the dark. Down you go.

steps._comment: == NOTE SURVEYOR PAGE == (2,2) down2 -> (2,4) (row y2 is a dead end this leg avoids entirely -- sewer_vermin (7,2) blocks straight through it, sewers_walkthrough's own route fights it there; row y4 is clear), right7 -> (9,4), up3 -> (9,2) (the third up step blocks on note_sewer_surveyor (9,1) & faces it).

payload_contains.text: Got: A Sewer Surveyor's Page, Water-Stained

steps._comment: == RECRUIT PELL == (9,2) down1 -> (9,3), right2 -> (10,3) (the second right step blocks on recruit_pell (11,3) & faces it). Single-option graph banks found_missing_recruit -- quest_beat_completed{beat:1} + the 'Quest updated' toast fire off record_accomplishment's own _check_quests() call.

Pell's single option carries BOTH effects AND end:true -- WIDialogue.choose() emits DIALOGUE_ENDED SYNCHRONOUSLY inside choose(), before returning to WIGame.dialogue_choose(), which only THEN applies the effects array -- so dialogue_ended/ui_dialogue_hidden fire BEFORE the accomplishment/quest events here (the opposite order from a goto-then-end-later node like Dresk's, where effects apply mid-conversation and dialogue_ended only fires on a LATER, separate interact).
steps.name: confirm

payload_contains.text: Quest updated: Walk Pell back to the barracks and tell Sergeant Ashgrave they're safe.

steps._comment: == JOURNAL LORE CHECK == the just-found note read back before the report leg.
steps.name: journal

steps._comment: == (4) DRESK, REPORT == teleport back to the barracks (same overworld-shortcut rationale as step 2), beside Dresk. social_talked is still set from the earlier visit (same waking), so a SINGLE interact reaches the graph directly. Visible options now: [0] Just checking in., [1] I found Pell. Safe, just turned around. (the ask option is hidden -- missing_recruit_started already banked).

payload_contains.speaker: Sergeant Ashgrave
payload_contains.text: Turned around, not hurt. That's the good version of this story. Four gold, out of my own kit budget — the Guild doesn't pay for finding my own people. Pell owes you a drink they can't afford yet.
